spanish: Y las grasas desde el toro y desde el carnero: la cola y lo cubriente y los riñones y lóbulo del hígado.

findings.issue: H451 denotes the fat tail (stout tail/rump); "cola" states only a generic tail, so the fat/stout component of the lemma is left unstated.
Definite masculine singular noun "covering" is smoothed into the neuter nominalized participle "lo cubriente" without a change of referent.

notes: Conjunction, both min phrases, plural fats, kidneys, and the liver construct are otherwise matched; the object marker adds no lexical item.
